title: Two Young Boys with Their Dog on Boulder, 1930s Outdoors B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait of two young brothers standing atop a large sunlit boulder with their small family dog poised alertly between them. Both boys are outfitted in period attire typical of the late 1930s, featuring light collared button-down shirts neatly tucked into high-waisted trousers with wide waistbands and belts. Dense trees and shrubbery fill the sunny background. The verso shows remnants of black scrapbook album paper along the edges and a faint stamped developer number reading '262'.
